# Televerse

Televerse exposes WebMCP tools for AI agents that need isolated side-task execution.

Machine-readable tool discovery:

- GET /api/webmcp
- Browser registration: document.modelContext
- Browser fallback: window.__opticonWebMcp

Available tools:

- teleport_agent: create an isolated side-task agent
- list_teleports: list side-task agents
- get_teleport_status: read side-task progress
- retrieve_teleport_result: retrieve a completed result
- apply_teleport_patch: mark a reviewed patch for application
- discard_teleport: discard a side task and workspace
- cancel_teleport: cancel a running side task
